aesthetics.typography: System sans stack (-apple-system/Helvetica-like) for everything: usernames and button labels
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat: usernames at 16px/400, Unfollow buttons at 16px/400 white on blue; no headings

notes: Capture state: the 'following' overlay is open over the IGdm messenger, covering it completely. It has no title. Its only chrome is a thin grey X in the top-right corner. There are 26 accounts in a centered 4-column grid with about 150px row pitch. The last row has only 2 tiles, centered (flex-wrap with justify-content center). Avatars are 48px circles: either flat cartoon illustrations on pastel gradient backgrounds, or monogram circles with serif initials inside a thin inner ring. The Unfollow buttons are Bootstrap-like solid #168bf9 with 4px radius. Because the corners mix circular avatars with slightly rounded rectangular buttons, shape is coded as mixed.
